<Callout type="info">
The Philippines targets increasing renewable energy share progressively toward 35%+ by 2030-2040 under RA 9513 (Renewable Energy Act of 2008)., making sustainable building systems essential for compliance and operational cost reduction.
</Callout>

blocks.raw:
<Callout type="warning">
Design integration sequencing matters: establish passive design envelope first, then size active systems to remaining load. Reverse sequencing typically increases equipment costs 20-30% while reducing actual performance by 10-15%.
</Callout>
